detailed_description:
The video is a cinematic high-fashion commercial shot in a warm, golden hour light with a soft, ethereal glow over the city skyline.

[Shot 1] The video opens exactly as shown in <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> is leaning against a black metal railing on a rooftop, her blonde hair gently windswept. She is holding <Subject 2> in her right hand. As the scene unfolds, <Subject 1> slowly raises <Subject 2> upward, lifting the coral lipstick toward the golden skyline and the distant skyscrapers as if offering a toast to the city. After a brief pause at the peak of the gesture, she smoothly rotates her body and turns her head toward the lens. She looks directly into the camera with a radiant, bright, and confident smile, highlighting the coral shade of her lips. The camera is a Static Shot, maintaining a medium shot composition throughout the 6-second duration to emphasize the subject's movement and expression. The lighting remains consistent with the sunset hues of <Picture 1>, casting a warm rim light on <Subject 1>'s hair and the metallic surface of <Subject 2>.

overall_soundscape:
The ambient sound consists of a low-frequency distant train rumble coming from the tracks below and the soft, steady whistling of rooftop wind. There are subtle foley sounds of fabric rustling as <Subject 1> turns.
